Launchers"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" run on Windows, macOS and Linux."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# vn-code"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Agent-Human ADE ⌨️"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Bundles Plugins, Skills and Interfaces"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Cross-platform Node ADE with core DSH for professional Engineering and Design: every plugin is **Nod"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"e.js** (plain JavaScript bundles, zero npm dependencies), while **Rust** is only the small front-doo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"r installer binary that composes the harness home and runs the launcher. The launchers run on **Wind"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ows, macOS and Linux**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Run"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | Windows | macOS / Linux |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **The app** | `scripts\run-desktop.bat` | `./scripts/run-desktop.sh` |
| **Browser tab only** | `s"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"cripts\run-web.bat` | `./scripts/run-web.sh` |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`run-web` starts the pinned harness and opens the URL it prints in Chrome, falling back to
your defa"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ult browser. `run-desktop` builds `vncode` when there is none and runs it: it
installs the pack if t"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"he home in use lacks it, asks for the DeepSeek key if there is none,
and then runs that same `run-we"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"b` in the foreground."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`vncode` is a small Rust binary - about **0.5 MB per OS** - with **no window and no embedded
browser"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"**: the interface is the same web application, in the browser you already use. Its
verbs are `start`"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" (the default), `install`, `uninstall`, `status` and `key`; `-Help` lists
the flags, and `app/README"},{"id":"p10s4","text":".md` is the whole app on one page."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`vncode` never runs node itself: it starts `scripts/run-web.*`, which does. Nothing it does
needs a "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"window, a port or a browser of its own."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The URL is opened only when it names a **loopback** address, and the launch token is never
written t"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"o a file - both rules are in SECURITY.md."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Plugins"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Every package's own README is the reference for what it does, why it is built that
way and what it t"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ouches. The exact versions are in
`.dsh-version.json`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Package | What it adds |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `dsh-vn-master` | the browser-free master, installed **last** - the slot pack-wide patches and row"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" restatements go in (it enables the Browser tab on the web profile, and removes the feedback surface"},{"id":"p17s3","text":") |
| `dsh-rightbar` | the pack's own right bar: tab strip, docking panel and the `sidebarRight` reg"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"istry (a fork of the shipped bar) |
| `dsh-rightbar-files` | the Files tab type on top of that bar |"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"
| `dsh-editor` | text and code tabs (vendored CodeMirror 6), with a Markdown preview and Save/Creat"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"e |
| `dsh-gittree` | **read-only** History tab: the workspace's commits as a graph rail (lanes, mer"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ges, PR chips), and the files each one touched |
| `dsh-image` | an image viewer that fits, zooms, p"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ans, and reads the source pixel under the pointer |
| `dsh-image-upscale` | the agent can make a sma"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ll image **big without making it worse**: four `upscale_*` tools over **Real-ESRGAN** (`realesr-gene"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"ral-x4v3` by default) run through the Python and torch **this machine already has** — `upscale_info`"},{"id":"p17s11","text":" says whether CUDA is there and which models are on disk, `upscale_image` writes a NEW file (never t"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"he original) with the model, device, ms and bytes in the answer, `upscale_batch` takes a manifest an"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"d is a dry run by DEFAULT (existing outputs skipped, not replaced), and `upscale_fetch_weights` down"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"loads one 4.7 MB model only after `confirm` repeats its name. Zero npm dependencies, no engine bundl"},{"id":"p17s15","text":"ed, and a four-line `torchvision.transforms.functional_tensor` shim so a `realesrgan` that is broken"},{"id":"p17s16","text":" against torchvision 0.17+ still runs |
| `dsh-audio` | a waveform surface: WAV/AIFF/FLAC, one track"},{"id":"p17s17","text":" per channel, dBFS, selection and playback |
| `dsh-media` | media the agent can work with: `media_p"},{"id":"p17s18","text":"robe` / `media_run` / `media_frames` over a **pinned, SHA-256-verified** ffmpeg copy, plus the route"},{"id":"p17s19","text":"s the video tab streams through |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Third-party content the pack vendors"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Some bundles carry somebody else's work inside them. Nothing is fetched at run
time — the profile in"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"stalls a bundle as a live link, so an engine the plugin needs
on both sides of the app has to be on "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"disk — and every vendored tree keeps its
upstream `LICENSE` beside its bytes."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| what | bundles | how it is kept honest |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| **Mermaid** 11.17.2 (`lib/vendor/mermaid.min.js`) | `dsh-diagrams` | `node packages/dsh-diagrams/v"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"endor/build.mjs --check` re-hashes the recorded sha256 |
| **Diagram Design** — 204 worked examples,"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" 44 documented visual types, 62 reference documents, MIT, `cathrynlavery/diagram-design` | `dsh-diag"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"rams` | `node packages/dsh-diagrams/vendor/design/build.mjs --check` re-hashes the whole 277-file tr"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ee OFFLINE against a pinned commit |
| **pdf.js** 6.3.289 (`lib/vendor/pdf.min.mjs` + worker, cmaps,"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" fonts, wasm) | `dsh-pdf` | `node packages/dsh-pdf/vendor/build.mjs --check`, per-file hashes plus a"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" digest per tree |
| **Impeccable** 4.6.0 (`@2f46b7a`, Apache-2.0) — the 24-command skill corpus and"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" 41 references, the 61-rule registry, and the detector built from the same `crates/core` + `crates/f"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"oundation` to `detect_bg.wasm` (4,558,054 bytes) + its CommonJS glue | `dsh-frontend-craft` | `node "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"packages/dsh-frontend-craft/vendor/impeccable/build.mjs --check` re-hashes every vendored file offli"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"ne against a pinned commit; the engine is built HERE from that pin (`build-engine.mjs`, 54 s cold) w"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"ith its Apache `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md` beside it, and `VERSION.json` records the four textual tran"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"sforms as well as every byte |

s"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"omebody else's bench. A commercial exception is available on request; see
CONTRIBUTING.md for the CL"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"A that keeps that possible, and
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md for the vendored trees that keep
their own li"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"censes (Apache-2.0, MIT, LGPL-2.1) and are **not** relicensed by this.
- SECURITY.md: the threat mod"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"el, the launch token, the code this pack
runs on purpose (`dsh-supercollider`'s interpreter and its "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"`eval` route among them),
what the pack deliberately does not do, and how `check-no-secrets.mjs` kee"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"ps a
credential out of a commit. Report a vulnerability privately, as described there.
- ARCHITECTUR"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"E.md is the deep dive; docs/ holds install,
distribute, compatibility and per-host notes."}],"truncated":true}
